summary: Phase-3 additive features verified end-to-end. Backend: 16/16 new pytest cases pass (attachments on queries & complaints, size + count limits, escalation tier logic for all 7 roles, professor analytics structure + actual counting after new prof answer). Frontend: escalation banner renders for Senior with correct text + Open Q&A navigation + dismiss; hidden for Student; nav-analytics is visible to Student (all roles); analytics-view renders with Prof. Alan Turing row after seeding an answered query; query and complaint attachment composer flow (chip + submit + gallery on card) works.

minor.issue: Size check is approximate (base64_len * 0.75). A payload right at the boundary could pass or fail inconsistently; consider real base64 decode length. Non-blocking.

Depends on 'Professor'/'Administrator' returning tier='any'; the spec says 'seniors' for Senior, 'alumni' for Alumni. Implementation matches. Note: seeded 3-day + 10-day queries mentioned in review_request were NOT present in DB when I inspected (only 1 DBMS seed on startup) — the endpoint still returns the correct shape and the banner did render for Senior (count=1) because a test-created answered query aged past 48h via seed + prior test runs. Main agent should verify seed script actually inserts the two aged queries if that was intended.

issues: prof-row text has no separator between the rank number and the professor's name (e.g. '1Prof. Alan Turing'). Minor; add a gap/margin.
Size displays as '0 KB' for a tiny 1x1 PNG (~68 bytes). Consider showing bytes when <1KB, or 'Math.max(1, kb)'. Cosmetic.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Fix rank/name spacing in analytics prof rows.
OPTIONAL: Improve attachment size formatting for sub-1KB files.
OPTIONAL: Verify seeded 3-day and 10-day queries are actually inserted on startup (I did not see them in server.py). Escalation banner still works via any aged escalated query.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _validate_attachments uses approximate base64 size (len*0.75). For strict enforcement decode the string and check byte length.

server.py compute_stage() calls parse_iso on every query fetch — fine for MVP, but analytics endpoint scans ALL queries twice (once for prof answers, once for open queries). Could combine into one pass.
App.js is now >1350 lines — even more overdue for splitting into per-feature modules (Queries.jsx, Complaints.jsx, ProfessorAnalytics.jsx, AttachmentPicker.jsx).
Escalation banner polls /api/notifications/escalations only on mount/login — no periodic refresh. Consider a 60s interval or SSE.
AttachmentPicker reads files via FileReader.readAsDataURL; error handling on read failure is not shown — should surface a toast if a file fails to load.
test_credentials: Used seeded creds from /app/memory/test_credentials.md — all 7 personas login OK.
seed_data_creation: test_phase3.py creates TEST_ prefixed queries/complaints via API. Non-destructive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase-3 fully green. New backend endpoints (/api/notifications/escalations, /api/analytics/professors) and attachment fields on POST /api/queries and POST /api/complaints all verified. UI test-ids used: escalation-banner, banner-goto-queries, banner-dismiss, nav-analytics, analytics-view, prof-row-{i}, query-attach-btn/input/chip/gallery, complaint-attach-*. Only cosmetic issues remain.
